meaning.en: Irrevocably is defined as something that is done in such a way that it cannot be undone.

meaning.en: In an irrevocable manner; beyond recall; in a manner precluding repeal.
meaning.vi: Theo cách không thể thu hồi; ngoài thu hồi; theo cách ngăn chặn việc bãi bỏ.
